عُشُقٌ , with two dammehs, A camel that keeps to the female which he covers and which desires none but him. (IAar, TA.) ＝
-A2- And Men who trim, or dress, or put into a good or right state, the sets [so I render غُرُوس, as pl. accord. to general analogy of غَرْسٌ,] of sweet-smelling plants. (IAar, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
